data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, not contingent on unanimity. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Versus 10, 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, 250-8k remain; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Even all 25 leave 50, but recovery isn't guaranteed. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. This may not maximize long-run income. Fisher20/22/18/01, please help recruit individual opt-ins.
